texts:
Friday's final injury reports are in for Week 5. Fourteen fantasy players are out, nobody we play is doubtful and sixteen are questionable.

Lamar Jackson is out.

Kyle Monangai is out, and D'Andre Swift is RB11 for me.

Let's get to it.
#RavensFlock #DaBears

Lamar Jackson (ankle) missed every practice and is out. Tyler Huntley starts Sunday night @ATL.

Pivot to Jayden Daniels, QB10 for me, back from the elbow.

Atlanta has no skill player on the report. Bijan Robinson is RB2 for me.
#RavensFlock #RaiseHail #DirtyBirds

Zay Flowers (foot) is questionable after three limited practices, with Huntley throwing to him. WR12 for me, borderline WR1/WR2; inactives at 6:50 PM ET.

Mark Andrews practiced in full all week. TE15 for me, a streamer.
#RavensFlock

Kyle Monangai (turf toe) is out after three missed practices and is in a walking boot, two to three weeks.

D'Andre Swift practiced in full Friday with no designation. RB11 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 with the backfield to himself.
#DaBears

Caleb Williams (hamstring) practiced once, Friday, and is questionable. Tyson Bagent starts @GB; sit Williams.

Colston Loveland drew 9 targets from Bagent in Week 4. TE10 for me, a borderline start.
#DaBears

Green Bay ruled out Chris Brooks (ankle), who started last week.

MarShawn Lloyd is the clear second back. RB33 for me, a low-end RB3.

Matthew Golden is WR16 for me this week, a WR2.
#GoPackGo

Ashton Jeanty went from a full Wednesday to no practice Friday with a foot injury on top of the ankle. Questionable, a true Sunday decision.

RB18 for me if active, an RB2. Have a backup ready.

Jalen Nailor (concussion) is out. Pivot to Tre Tucker, WR39.
#RaiderNation

Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is questionable after three limited practices. RB24 for me this week, an RB2.

TreVeyon Henderson is RB30 for me, a high-end RB3.

Mack Hollins (calf) is out. Romeo Doubs is WR26, a high-end WR3.
#NEPats

Stefon Diggs (hamstring) missed every practice and is out.

Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was limited Friday after two missed days. Questionable and outside my top 50 receivers. Monitor; inactives Sunday.

Pivot to Antonio Williams, WR44, a dart throw.
#RaiseHail

Malik Nabers practiced in full Friday and has no designation. WR13 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week @WAS.

Cam Skattebo also finished with a full practice. RB19 for me this week, an RB2.

Isaiah Likely is TE6 for me.
#NYGiants

Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) practiced in full Friday but is still in the protocol and questionable. Monitor; his clearance before Sunday's inactives.

Tee Higgins (groin, neck) missed two days, then practiced in full. Questionable. Monitor; Sunday's inactives.
#WhoDey

If both Cincinnati receivers sit, Dohnte Meyers is WR36 for me, a low-end WR3, and Mike Gesicki is TE12, a borderline start.

Jaylen Wright (foot) is questionable for Miami. Sit him; Ollie Gordon II is RB28, a high-end RB3.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

London, 9:30 AM ET, inactives at 8:00 AM ET.

Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is out. Pivot to Will Shipley, RB22 for me this week, an RB2.

DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is out.
Hollywood Brown (ankle) is out.
Pivot to Dontayvion Wicks, WR37, a low-end flex play.
#FlyEaglesFly

Dallas Goedert is back from the knee with no designation after a full Friday; Johnny Mundt goes back to blocking.

Jalen Hurts is QB17 for me, a streamer.

Jacksonville has no skill player on the report. Bhayshul Tuten is RB14, borderline RB1/RB2.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Justin Jefferson (ankle) is questionable after three limited practices and says he plays @NO. WR17 for me this week, a WR2.

Jordan Addison (hamstring) is questionable too. WR34 for me, a low-end WR3.
#Skol

Chris Olave practiced in full Friday and has no designation. WR6 for me vs MIN.

Alvin Kamara (back) is questionable after two limited days. RB26 for me, a high-end RB3.

Tyler Shough is QB13 for me, a borderline start.
#Saints

Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) is out multiple weeks. DK Metcalf is WR18 for me, a WR2.

Pivot to Roman Wilson, WR47, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

Rico Dowdle (toe) is questionable after three limited days. Monitor; Sunday's inactives.
#HereWeGo

Keenan Allen practiced in full Friday and is questionable. Outside my top 50 receivers in his first game back; sit him.

Josh Downs keeps the slot. WR21 for me this week, a WR2.

Jonathan Taylor has no designation. RB3 for me.
#ForTheShoe

Carnell Tate (back) is questionable after two limited days, and Robert Saleh says he is good to go. WR23 for me this week, a WR2.

Tony Pollard practiced in full Thursday and Friday. RB29, a high-end RB3.

Nico Collins has no designation. WR8 for me.
#TitanUp #HTownMade

Ladd McConkey (foot) did not practice all week and is questionable. Sit him.

Quentin Johnston (chest) is out. Pivot to Tre' Harris, WR35 for me, a low-end WR3.

Pat Bryant went to IR. Pivot to Courtland Sutton, WR42, a low-end flex play.
#BoltUp #BroncosCountry

Zach Charbonnet (knee) is out. Emanuel Wilson is RB16 for me this week, an RB2.

Mike Evans (ribs) is off the final injury report with no designation. WR24 for me @SEA, a WR2.

George Kittle is TE4 for me.
#Seahawks #FTTB

Breece Hall (quad) is out. Pivot to Braelon Allen, RB15 for me this week, an RB2.

Mason Taylor is back from the thumb. Kenyon Sadiq is TE14, a borderline start.

Quinshon Judkins has no designation. RB17, an RB2.
#JetUp #DawgPound

Jeremiyah Love practiced in full Friday on the ankle and has no designation. RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 vs DET.

Detroit has no skill player on the report. Jahmyr Gibbs is RB1 for me.

Trey McBride is TE1 for me.
#BirdGang #OnePride

Buffalo and the Rams play Monday and post designations Saturday.

DJ Moore (shoulder) missed Thursday's practice and is off the Menu. Keon Coleman is WR40 for me, a low-end flex play.

Davante Adams took a rest day. WR10 for me.
#BillsMafia #RamsHouse

Every designation, practice report and pivot is in Prep Notes on the site, and the Menu is refreshed.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's inactives and pivots, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/prep.html?week=5
